+"""Standalone copy of ``_pytest.pathlib.get_extended_length_path_str``.
+
+This module must stay importable by file path without loading ``_pytest``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_extended_path", "vendored_extended_path_variant"]
+
+
+def vendored_extended_path(path: str) -> str:
+    """Convert a path to a Windows extended length path."""
+    long_path_prefix = "\\\\?\\"
+    unc_long_path_prefix = "\\\\?\\UNC\\"
+    if path.startswith((long_path_prefix, unc_long_path_prefix)):
+        return path
+    # UNC
+    if path.startswith("\\\\"):
+        return unc_long_path_prefix + path[2:]
+    return long_path_prefix + path
+
+
+def vendored_extended_path_variant(path: str) -> str:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_extended_path`, but convert forward slashes to
+    backslashes first."""
+    return vendored_extended_path(path.replace("/", "\\"))

+# mypy: allow-untyped-defs
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_extended_path.py"
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "_standalone_wave6_extended_path_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mod() -> ModuleType:
+    return _load_module()
+
+
+def test_module_does_not_import_pytest_pathlib(monkeypatch) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "_pytest.pathlib", None)
+    module = _load_module()
+    assert module.__all__ == [
+        "vendored_extended_path",
+        "vendored_extended_path_variant",
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("path", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("c:\\foo", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"),
+        ("\\\\?\\c:\\foo", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"),
+        ("\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share", "\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share"),
+        ("\\\\server\\share", "\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share"),
+        ("c:/foo/bar", "\\\\?\\c:/foo/bar"),
+        ("", "\\\\?\\"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vendored_extended_path(mod, path: str, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert mod.vendored_extended_path(path) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("platform", ["win32", "linux"])
+def test_vendored_extended_path_is_platform_independent(
+    mod, monkeypatch, platform: str
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", platform)
+    assert mod.vendored_extended_path("c:\\foo") == "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("path", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("c:/foo/bar", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo\\bar"),
+        ("c:\\foo", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"),
+        ("//server/share", "\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share"),
+        ("//?/c:/foo", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"),
+        ("//?/UNC/server/share", "\\\\?\\UNC\\server\\share"),
+        ("\\\\?\\c:\\foo", "\\\\?\\c:\\foo"),
+        ("", "\\\\?\\"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vendored_extended_path_variant(mod, path: str, expected: str) -> None:
+    assert mod.vendored_extended_path_variant(path) == expected
+
+
+def test_variant_delegates_to_vendored_function(mod, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    calls: list[str] = []
+
+    def fake(path: str) -> str:
+        calls.append(path)
+        return "result"
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "vendored_extended_path", fake)
+    assert mod.vendored_extended_path_variant("a/b") == "result"
+    assert calls == ["a\\b"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "func_name", ["vendored_extended_path", "vendored_extended_path_variant"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [None, 1, b"c:/foo"])
+def test_non_str_raises(mod, func_name: str, bad: object) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError if isinstance(bad, bytes) else AttributeError):
+        getattr(mod, func_name)(bad)
